title: Vampires Have "Disappointing" Q4 Feastings Call
subtitle: It's not as easy to suck the life out of us as it once was.
body_html:
For the last several years, my readers have been delighted by the horrifying reality of vampires being acquired by private equity. Vampire covens have had a dehydrated human flock, avoidance of activity in public, where their blood can be most rapidly drained, and more time on TikTok live. The cost of capital has also increased pressures on the bottom line of their private equity acquirers, and the market has not been favorable to IPO. Prior Articles in the series will be peppered throughout if you need to catch up.

Join me for today's earnings call with Last Choice Blood Care Partners, the first publicly traded vampire coven roll-up, facing a difficult Q4 feasting call…

Operator

Good afternoon. My name is Domingo—yes, we are hearing it directly from me—and I will be your conference operator today. I want to welcome everyone to the LastChoice BloodCare fourth quarter and full vampiric year 2024 conference call. [Operator instructions] I will now turn the conference call over to Brett Whiteman, senior vice president of investor relations.

Mr Whiteman, you may now begin your conference.

Brett Whiteman -- Vice President, Investor Relations

Thank you, Domingo, and good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining us today to discuss LCBCP's fourth quarter and full vampiric year 2024 results. Today's discussion will be led by Dracula, chairman and chief executive officer, and Maria Soprano, executive vice president and chief financial officer. This conference call will include backward-looking statements, subject to various risks and uncertainties that could cause our results to differ materially from these statements. Any such statement should be considered in conjunction with cautionary statements in our blood-sucking reports and risk factors discussed in our filings with the SEC, including our latest annual report on Form 10-Hell and quarterly report on Form 10-Night.

There is no obligation to update any of these backward-looking statements or information. GAAP (Ghoulish Ascedency and Ancient Protocols accounting standards) results in fourth quarter fiscal year 2024's comparative period include several items related to strategic actions, including restructuring and impairment induced as a result of draining our human flock, and other items.

[the line cuts out, static, and resumes]

Domingo: please stand by, we are having technical difficulties communing between the living and the de—oh, we are back!

Brett Whiteman: These quotidian findings are excluded from our non-GAAP results. All numbers referenced on today's call are on a non-GAAP basis unless otherwise noted, or there is no non-GAAP adjustment related to the eventual and inevitable triumph of the night.

As part of our non-GAAP results, blood sucked, life-or-death margin, and Blood-per-sheeple metrics on today's call are measured in constant units of volume, whereby current period volumes are converted into from liters into metric using the average monthly drainage rates from the comparative period rather than the actual drainage rates for the current period, excluding related hedging-out-bets activities. For non-GAAP volumetric measures mentioned in today's call, please refer to the drainings release on our website at bloodsucking.vampites.com to find reconciliations of those non-GAAP measures to their corresponding GAAP measures. This conference call is being webcast, and a cypt of the webcast will be available on our deep underground, in our ancient burial facility, through Friday, December 13th, 2024. Also, for your calendar planning purposes, please note that our first quarter fiscal year 2025 earnings conference call has been tentatively scheduled for Tuesday, January 28th, 2025.

With that, I now have the privilege of turning it over to Dracula.

Dracula -- Chairman and Chief Vampire Officer

Thank you, Brett, and bad night. Thank you for joining us this evening. LastChoice is one of the world's most ancient bloodlines and most iconic brands. It really is my privilege to take on this role, and I'm excited to return here, to my ancestral resting place, and optimistic about the future of undeath. Since re-joining LastChoice last month, I've spent my time digging into the graves, listening to screams, and sampling the delicious lifeblood of our human flock.

These experiences and my learnings have helped me form a clear understanding of where we are and what we need to do differently in our quest to bend the entire world to our will. Everything I have seen and heard tells me we have significant strengths to build on. The brand is strong and enduring—eternal, in fact. We have deep blood supply chain expertise, and we have a fantastic team of seductive individuals who can lure ever more sheeple into our clutches.

I look forward to sharing more about my plan to get Back to Blood— our plan for domination over all who dare to draw breath, with you shortly. But first, I'd like to turn it over to Maria for a more detailed overview of our final Q4 and full fiscal year 2024 volumetric results. Maria?

Maria Soprano -- Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer

Thank you, Dracula, my lord, and sire, and welcome to your first LastChoice earnings call. Good evening, everyone. As you saw in our press release last week, our volume challenges persisted in Q4, resulting in pressures throughout our P&L (punctures and leakage report) from our top line to our bottom line. With that, I'll briefly discuss our Q4 and full-year results and then turn the call over to Dracula. In regards to Q4, our Q4 consolidated drainings was 9.1 standardized deciliters, down 3% from the prior year, driven by a 7% decline in single human subject suckings, consisting of an 8% decrease in volume per subject and a 2% increase in average puncture time per subject, partially offset by 7% net new coven-operated vampires tuned to undeath and the dark, forever.

The blood volume decrease was primarily due to a 6% increase in U.S. colleagues with stakes driven into their dark hearts, driven by a 10% uptick in comparable vampire hunters, partially offset by a 4% decrease in holy water use by the hunters, mainly from the decrease in any priests to bless the holy water used, since ancient times. The volume of blood declined across all routes of peripheral access, including parts of the night, with the most pronounced decline in the late-evening-drainings from the Internal Jugular. In addition to the continued decline of non-LastChoice Rewards member suckings, frequency also slowed across all Rewards members to the prior year and ultimately impacted total blood sucked.

While active Rewards membership grew 4% year over year to 33.8 million human sheep willingly serving themselves up to our sires, it remained flat to Q3 as our in-enclave offerings, as well as promotions like the unsuccessful “pumpkin-blood” promotion, did not create sustained excitement or the stickiness we had anticipated from the sheeple on which we so greedily feed. Our Q4 results also reflected China's comparable volume drainage decline of 14%, driven by an 8% decline in average volume and a 6% decline in time in-vein for our IV operations in mainland China, weighed down by intensified competition and a soft undeath environment that impacted consumer desire to escape, even for a moment, their drap and miserable lives via our offerings. Although the market reached an all-time high of 23.5 million Rewards active members during the quarter with 2.2 million net new members versus the prior year, actual blood declined due to non-Rewards members just deciding to stay home and play video games instead of flailing the night away in settings more conducive to literally sucking the life out of them. This, in turn, elevated discounting of volumetric results, given the highly promotional environment and lower volume of hard-to-drain sheeple impacted by reluctant and dead-in-the-eyes consumers using TikTok instead of relaxing into our deathly embrace. Shifting to fractionation.

Our Q4 consolidated plasma proportion was 14.4%, contracting 370 milliliters per human from the prior year, primarily driven by hypovolemia, dehydration in those who can’t bother even to drink some water throughout the day, and partners like Starbucks reducing foot traffic that had provided a volumetric boost, and decreased promotional activities at Key partners like Spirit Halloween. The contraction was partially offset by seduction and volume drained at political rallies in the 2024 election season. In the grave, we successfully got increased platelets-per-flock members, contributing to low junior sire turnover and our increased revenue from partners in the medical industry. However, we have additional work to do to resolve the staffing shortages of our Lycanthropic and Skeletal junior associates.

[static, the line cuts out, and there is a 5:33 long garbling of speech, and the call resumes audibility thereafter]

… I have confidence in our ability to turn around our bloodline’s precipitous decline.

I have the utmost confidence in our partners around the globe and in the fact that we can drain humans dry, together. With that, I'll now turn the call over to Dracula.

Dracula -- Chairman and Chief Vampire Officer

Thank you, Maria—she is a vampire I turned myself and I relish her thorough reporting. Our financial results were very disappointing, and it is clear we need to fundamentally change our strategy to win back sheeply and return to rivers of blood. Back to Blood is that fundamental change. We have to get back to what has always set LastChoice apart: a foreboding graveyard next to a dance club where people gather and where we suck their blood, with our fangs, by our ancient sires.

Regardless of the consumer environment, we must be at our best to drink enough blood to be sated, but not so much that we kill the humans before they can bring others to our sexy clubs to fall under our thrall. And right now, despite the hard work of our Rappers like Diddy, we aren't always at our most seductive. I've heard that while people love getting away from their wretched lives, some feel like we have drifted from our most vital needs like “more blood” and “staying out of the sunlight.” We've made it harder to be a victim than it should be, and we focused our marketing too narrowly on LastChoice Rewards members—frankly, we were sucking our most ardent members of the flock dry. This just isn’t sustainable.

I've spent my career understanding, destroying, and stewarding the living across the river Styx and back again as the undead and damned. The LastChoice brand is iconic and feared. My experience tells me that when we get Back to our core identity and consistently demand a great experience for ourselves first, and if we are demanding enough, the humans will return to our lairs. Our problems are fixable. Most of what we need to do is in our cold, deathly hands already!

So, our path forward is clear. With our U.S. Covens being our priority, work is already underway. Some things will take some time as we savor and learn, but we're moving with slow, relentless purpose on the things we can.

I want to share a few examples. We have to make it easier for our humans to get blood sucked out of their circulatory system. We now will move to prioritize toil across the U.S. centers of dread to support throughput with this goal in mind.

We want to hand deliver a high-volume amount of blood to our sires in four minutes or less and deliver sweet release from their mundane cares on time for our human flock every time. We have work to do to achieve this consistently, but we've learned lessons from our success in improving the mobile app experience and reducing the wait times for venipuncture. Our throughput with volume aspirations and getting the core sucking experience right will drive everything we do and every decision we make. The moment our sires bite down directly on the neck of a human, this is our brand moment of truth.

[static, and the call drops…deathly silent]

Thank you for reading. Make sure to savor prior articles like:
